title: 第13章 特大车祸第14章 麻烦来了
lines: 从庆德市到东河市，两个多小时的车程。不知不觉就已经到了。再次回到东河，高山也深深的吸了一口气。如今父母是不需要担心了。那么接下来就是全心全意的忙碌自己的事情了。
直接坐地铁到附二院。刚走出地铁口，高山就愣住了。此时整个附二院门口的道路已经被临时交通管制起来了。
附二院这一段路大约两百多米的距离范围之内，一头一台警车，此刻正闪烁着警灯。一边有三四名警察站在了道路中央。原本车水马龙的道路变得空空荡荡。不时可以看到有救护车呼啸着进来，然后又呼啸着出去。
一看到这个情况，熟悉医院流程和应急制度的高山顿时心中一紧——这是出紧急突发事件了。看这个架势应该还是群体性的。就是不知道是车祸还是其他。
来不及多想，也来不及细想，高山直接就冲过了马路。一进医院的急诊大厅，只听到了闹哄哄的声音。原本就拥挤不堪的急诊中心里面，此时此刻更是如同赶集的集市一样。拥挤的程度也就比小长假的旅游景点稍微好那么一点点了。
医生、护士每一个都是在紧张的忙碌着。此时都已经不是在走，而是在一路小跑了。急诊中心导诊服务台这边的两个护士也正在不断的接听电话和安排导诊分流。
“高山你愣着干嘛。赶紧的帮忙！”一个熟悉的声音在旁边响起，高山在骨外科实习的时候的带教老师邓小博喊了起来。
邓小博瞪了一眼，直接道：“我什么我，赶紧的帮忙，绕城高速发生特大车祸，一共六台旅游大巴连环追尾。因为我们附二院还承担着省急救中心的职责，现在是大部分的伤者都涌过来了。如今全院上下，除了值班的、手术的、门诊的，只要是清闲的，不管是医生还是实习生都过来了。赶紧给我帮一把手。”
在骨外实习的两个月，高山也算是了解邓小博这个人了。年富力强，属于医院的中坚力量，水平也扎实。就是性格有些直，所以到现在还在副高的级别上逗留。按理说，以邓小博的水平和条件。正高是完全足够了。
正如现在，邓小博也只是来帮忙的。更何况高山不过是他带过的学生，现在又不在他科室实习了。换成其他人，哪怕再忙估计也不会喊他。
“好的。邓老师。”高山也不推诿，直接就点头应承了下来。行李包往导诊台里面一放，对着护士道：“两位姐姐，我是外一的实习生，以前是邓老师的徒弟，包就先放这里了。能借一件白大褂么？”
话音刚落，邓小博就喊了起来：“还换什么白大褂啊。赶紧的干活！这边这个左手骨折的交给你了。”
这话只让两个接电话的护士都抿嘴笑了一下。很显然她们对于邓小博的名声早已经是了解了。
高山讪笑了一下立刻就迎了上去。这种突发的事件，尤其是这种严重的群体性车伤事件。一旦忙碌起来场面是十分吓人的。
因为在车伤的严重伤员的感染之下。每一个人都是人心惶惶的。并不是所有的人都懂医，所以，每一个伤者。不分轻重都会有一种恐惧，对车祸的恐惧，对自身生命是否有危险的恐惧。
高山眼前的这个患者也是这样。其实他也就是伤了左手而已。可此刻却是躺在了担架上不断的在惨叫哀嚎着，再加上衣服上、脸上、手上和腿上都沾满了鲜血，外表的确是挺吓人的。那感觉，整个急诊中心也就他的情况最危险。
径直走到了这个患者的前面，高山的脸上看不到半分的惊慌，无比的镇定。甚至显得有些轻车熟路。直接上去，拍了拍伤者的脸蛋。让伤者的注意力放到自己身上。高山开口道：“大哥，别喊了。整个大楼光听到你的声音了。看你中气十足。放心吧。没啥问题的。”
正说着，门口救护车一阵急促刹车声，车门打开，一个担架推车直接下来。门口等候迎接的急诊医生和护士再加上救护车的随行人员一路小跑的推了进来。急诊医生整个人已经跨在了伤者的身上，双手也已经开始了心外心按压！
“让一让！都让一让！”护士一边控制着车子的方向，一边大喊，同时还对着导诊那边道：“小敏，几号抢救室？”
导诊台这边的护士立刻回应道：“9号！”
随着车子呼啸而过，高山转头道：“大哥，看到没？这才是重伤员，什么时候你要是喊不出了，什么时候，我也这么推你了。那你就真的是重伤了。”
“哎呀，你这医生，你这是咒我呢？”这大哥也是个妙人，立刻就不满的反驳起来。
高山笑着道：“哪能啊，大哥，你看现在是不是不怕了？不紧张了？”
“你……医生，还别说啊。真没那么怕了。你这心理战术不错啊。可我这身上这么多血。”
高山已经到了伤者的左侧，其实已经伸手抓住了伤者的左上肢。皮肤没有破损，肘关节下部十公分左右，靠外侧稍微有些肿胀和凸起。很显然这是桡骨骨折了。不过不严重，想想也是，如果严重。邓小博也不会让高山来处理了。
一边检查，高山一边笑着道：“这血可都不是你的。你想多了。你真要出这么多血，就不是现在这样了。”
“这……啊！”这个大哥正准备说呢。突然一声惨叫。
实际上在高山说话的时候，高山双手就已经一前一后扯住了伤者的手臂。就在伤者开口说话，注意力分神的时候，高山动了。按照现代中医正骨手法来说，高山刚刚施展的是摇摆触碰、手摸心会和拉伸牵引以及加挤分骨。按照古代中医来说，这算是摸、接、提的手法。
可在高山的医学传承里面，这却是属于按摩八术里面的手法之一。对于这种高山有着很强的自信，别看就这么一下，骨折复位的程度绝对是完美的。
随着复位完成，高山直接喊道：“小敏姐，拿一副夹板给我。”
content_en:
It takes more than two hours to drive from Qingde City to Donghe City. Before I knew it, I had arrived. Returning to Donghe again, Gao Shan also took a deep breath. Now parents don't need to worry. Then the next step is to concentrate on your own affairs.
Take the subway directly to the Second Affiliated Hospital. As soon as he stepped out of the subway entrance, Gao Shan was stunned. At this time, the entire road at the entrance of the Second Affiliated Hospital has been temporarily restricted by traffic.
Within a distance of about two hundred meters on the road to the Second Affiliated Hospital, there was a police car at one end, with its lights flashing at the moment. There were three or four policemen standing in the middle of the road on one side. Roads that were once bustling with traffic became empty. From time to time, you can see ambulances roaring in and then roaring out.
When he saw this situation, Gao Shan, who was familiar with hospital procedures and emergency systems, suddenly felt nervous - this was an emergency. Judging from this posture, it should still be a group one. I just don’t know if it was a car accident or something else.
There was no time to think about it, no time to dwell on it, Gao Shan rushed across the road directly. As soon as I entered the emergency hall of the hospital, I heard only noisy sounds. The emergency center, which was already overcrowded, felt like a market at this moment. The level of crowding is only slightly better than tourist attractions during short holidays.
Doctors and nurses are all busy. At this time, they were no longer walking, but trotting all the way. The two nurses at the emergency center’s consultation service desk are also constantly answering calls and arranging diversion.
"Gao Shan, what are you doing standing still? Hurry and help!" A familiar voice sounded next to him, Deng Xiaobo, Gao Shan's teacher during his internship in orthopedic surgery, shouted.
"I..."
Deng Xiaobo glared and said directly: "What am I, please help quickly. There was a huge car accident on the Ring Expressway, and a total of six tourist buses rear-ended each other. Because our Second Affiliated Hospital is also responsible for the provincial emergency center, most of the injured have come here. Now, in the whole hospital, except for those on duty, surgery, and outpatients, as long as they have free time, doctors and interns have all come over. Hurry and help me."
During the two months of internship at the Department of Orthopedics, Gao Shan finally got to know Deng Xiaobo. He is young and powerful, belongs to the backbone of the hospital, and his level is solid. It's just that he has a somewhat straight personality, so he is still at the deputy senior level. It stands to reason that given Deng Xiaobo's level and conditions. The height is completely sufficient.
Just like now, Deng Xiaobo is only here to help. What's more, Gao Shan was just a student he had taught, and now he was no longer an intern in his department. If it had been anyone else, no matter how busy they were, they probably wouldn't have called him.
"Okay. Teacher Deng." Gao Shan didn't hesitate and nodded directly in agreement. He put the luggage bag inside the consultation desk and said to the nurse: "Sisters, I am an intern in the first department, and I used to be Teacher Deng's apprentice, so the bag will be placed here first. Can I borrow a white coat?"
As soon as he finished speaking, Deng Xiaobo shouted: "Why don't you change into a white coat? Work quickly! The one with a broken left hand here is left to you."
These words only made the two nurses who answered the phone purse their lips and smile. Obviously they already knew about Deng Xiaobo's reputation.
Gao Shan smiled sarcastically and immediately greeted him. This kind of sudden incident, especially this kind of serious mass car injury incident. Once it gets busy, the scene is very scary.
Because of the infection caused by serious car injuries. Everyone is worried. Not everyone knows medicine, so every injured person. No matter how serious it is, there will be a kind of fear, fear of car accidents, fear of whether one's own life is in danger.
The same is true for the patient in front of Gao Shan. In fact, he just injured his left hand. But at this moment, he was lying on a stretcher, screaming and wailing. In addition, his clothes, face, hands and legs were covered with blood. The appearance was indeed quite scary. It felt like his situation was the most dangerous in the entire emergency center.
Walking straight in front of the patient, Gao Shan couldn't see any panic on his face and was extremely calm. It even seems a bit familiar. He went up directly and patted the injured man's face. Let the injured person focus on themselves. Gao Shan said: "Brother, stop shouting. The whole building has heard your voice. You look very angry. Don't worry. There's nothing wrong with it."
Just as he was talking, the ambulance braked suddenly at the door, the door opened, and a stretcher trolley came straight out. The emergency doctors and nurses waiting to greet him at the door, together with the ambulance attendants, trotted in. The emergency doctor had already straddled the injured person's body and started performing extracardiac compressions with both hands!
"Make way! Give way, everyone!" the nurse shouted while controlling the direction of the car. At the same time, she also said to the guide: "Xiao Min, what is the emergency room number?"
The nurse at the guidance desk immediately responded: "No. 9!"
As the car whizzed by, Gao Shan turned around and said, "Brother, did you see? This is the seriously injured person. If you couldn't scream, then I would push you like this. Then you are really seriously injured."
"Oh, you doctor, are you cursing me?" This elder brother was also a wonderful person, and he immediately retorted dissatisfiedly.
Gao Shan smiled and said: "How can you, brother, do you think you are not afraid now? Are you not nervous anymore?"
"You...doctor, don't say it yet. I'm really not that scared anymore. Your psychological tactics are good. But there is so much blood on my body."
Gao Shan had reached the left side of the injured person and actually reached out and grabbed the injured person's left upper limb. The skin is not damaged, but the lower part of the elbow joint, about ten centimeters away, is slightly swollen and bulging on the outside. Apparently it was a fractured radius. But it's not serious, think about it, if it is serious. Deng Xiaobo would not let Gao Shan handle it.
While checking, Gao Shan said with a smile: "This blood is not yours. You think too much. If you really had to bleed so much, it wouldn't be like this now."
"This...ah!" The elder brother was about to say. Suddenly there was a scream.
In fact, when Gao Shan was talking, Gao Shan's hands were already holding the injured man's arms one after another. Just when the wounded man spoke and his attention was distracted, the mountain moved. According to modern TCM bone-setting techniques, what Gao Shan just performed was rocking and touching, hand-to-heart contact, stretching and traction, and bone-squeezing and splitting. According to ancient Chinese medicine, this is a technique of touching, catching and lifting.
But in Gaoshan's medical heritage, this is one of the eight massage techniques. I have a lot of confidence in this kind of high mountain. Even if I just look at it, the degree of fracture reduction is absolutely perfect.
As the reset was completed, Gao Shan shouted directly: "Sister Xiao Min, give me a pair of splints."
title_en: Chapter 13 A huge car accident Chapter 14 Trouble is coming
